name: smwmusic-labyrinth-forest-of-the-archmuse-the-archmuse
title: Labyrinth Forest of the Archmuse - The Archmuse
description:
A solemn hymn, greeting travelers with a question as they enter the Labyrinth Forest, and likewise ushering them out with a similar tune as the travelers leave with the truth of the forest in tow. Good for cutscenes and more ethereal overworlds.

OPTIONS:
This song has 2 separate toggle options that control the key and version specifically. The first option has 3 settings for whether the song loops, ends early, or resolves, and the second option has 2 settings, to set either the key signature for the intro version or the outro version.

This was part of a larger song I made for a Battle of the Bits contest, where we were tasked with making a 5 minute long song in 4 hours. The intro and outro of that song have become this submission.
